title: Flatten All with reversible editability
summary: Merge all objects into the image while preserving exact output pixels and the ability to undo.

Added: Image > Flatten All and Ctrl+Shift+T merge all objects into the current raster. Undo restores editability, Redo flattens again, and saved version2 projects retain original pixels for Revert.
Fixed: Undo/Redo now report the current object count when image dimensions stay unchanged.
Verified: Native menu/keyboard flattening, resize-dialog shortcut suppression, Undo/Redo, native save and355200 unchanged clipboard pixels.
Installed reference shortcut and Undo/Redo behavior observed on synthetic content;81 regular Rust tests cover exact pixels, persistence, input ownership and atomic failure.
Roadmap: Added top-level Image menu control mapping and refreshed expired provisional targets without marking unfinished features complete.

limitations: Flattening selected objects and the Resize Image flattening confirmation remain planned.
Editable projects retain original pixels. Share a flattened PNG when original/redacted content must not be recoverable.
Version2 flattened projects require this alpha or newer supporting builds. Full reference UI parity is not claimed.
